experiences.title: Machine Learning Engineer
experiences.description: Built and implemented machine learning solutions under the Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative, including ML, DL, and NLP systems. Worked on 4 key projects: RAG System (DEPI Chatbot), Superstore Exploratory Data Analysis, Generate Caption of Image, and Text Summarization Using NLP. Implemented data preprocessing pipelines, developed and evaluated predictive models on real-world datasets, and applied statistical concepts to optimize model accuracy. Utilized Python, Scikit-learn, and TensorFlow to architect and deploy machine learning solutions.

case_studies.title: Travel Advisor Application
case_studies.description: Interactive travel dashboard for discovering restaurants, hotels, and attractions through a synchronized list-and-map experience.

details.overview: A responsive React application that helps users explore travel-related places through a clean split-screen interface combining search, filtering, and interactive maps.
details.problem: Travel discovery platforms often overwhelm users with scattered information and weak navigation between results and location context, making it harder to compare places quickly.
details.solution: Built a travel dashboard powered by the Travel Advisor API, where users can browse restaurants, hotels, and attractions, filter by category and rating, and switch smoothly between place cards and Leaflet map markers with synchronized selection.
details.results: Delivered a fast and responsive browsing experience that makes place discovery more intuitive, with richer decision-making support through ratings, reviews, pricing, awards, and direct external links.
details.challenges: Handled API inconsistency by normalizing place data into a unified structure, improved resilience with loading and retry states, and designed the UI so list interactions and map focus stay aligned across devices.

case_studies.alt: Nail Diseases Detection Using Image Processing & Deep Learning
case_studies.title: Nail Diseases Detection Using Image Processing & Deep Learning
case_studies.description: AI diagnostic system for nail diseases built with CNN architectures and deployed through Flask.

details.overview: A deep learning-based system designed to detect nail diseases from medical images and support early diagnosis.
details.problem: Manual diagnosis requires expertise and time, so users need a faster and more accessible solution.
details.solution: Implemented a pipeline using CNN, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 on 12,700 images, integrated with a Flask web app for real-time predictions.
details.results: Reached 89% accuracy and delivered a practical tool for faster preliminary diagnosis.
details.challenges: Handled image quality and lighting variations with augmentation and improved model selection through experimentation.

case_studies.title: DEPI Chatbot - RAG System
case_studies.description: Context-aware chatbot that combines retrieval and generation to answer DEPI initiative questions accurately.

details.overview: RAG chatbot that retrieves relevant context then generates grounded answers using LLMs.
details.problem: DEPI information is distributed across sources, making accurate search and support difficult.
details.solution: Used embeddings and vector search to retrieve documents, then passed context to an LLM for reliable answers.
details.results: Improved answer relevance and reduced manual effort in finding DEPI information.
details.challenges: Optimized retrieval quality and balanced factual grounding with natural conversational output.

case_studies.title: Text Summarization Using NLP
case_studies.description: Transformer-powered summarization app for long text and dialogue with fast, coherent output.

details.overview: NLP application that summarizes long inputs into concise and meaningful outputs.
details.problem: Long text and dialogue are time-consuming to process manually and difficult to scale.
details.solution: Built with BART-SAMSum, preprocessing, and Streamlit UI to generate quality summaries quickly.
details.results: Produced coherent summaries that reduced reading time while preserving key information.
details.challenges: Managed sequence-length limits and improved summary coherence for conversational inputs.
